about_the_game:
The Story Behind Truck Town 🚛✨

Truck Town started as a small passion project—a dad building a game for his 3-year-old son. Like many curious toddlers, his son loved watching him play video games but struggled to find a game designed for someone his age. Everything out there was either too complicated or meant for older kids. Most games don’t really start being accessible until age 6 and up.

So, this dad decided to build it himself. Using Unreal Engine, he created a simple prototype in just 24 hours. His son tried it—and immediately loved it. That quick experiment turned into Truck Town—a completely safe, single-player experience made specifically for toddlers and young kids aged 3 and up.

In Truck Town, your child drives a friendly truck using just the left joystick, making it the perfect way to introduce young players to using a controller. The game also supports keyboard input. Pressing any of the A, B, X, Y buttons (or keyboard keys) triggers fun, safe effects like silly horns or colorful sparkles.

Along the way, kids can drive through and collect floating spheres with numbers, colors, and animals—each one voiced out loud to encourage learning. There are no enemies, no failure states, no ads, no microtransactions—just a fun, relaxing space for kids to explore.

Truck Town was designed with a simple goal: Give toddlers a safe and joyful first experience with video games and controllers. And if one dad couldn’t find a game like this out there, chances are other parents were looking for the same thing. That’s why Truck Town is now on Steam—for anyone who wants their little one to learn, play, and explore safely.

About the Game:

Welcome to Truck Town! 🚚✨ A fun and engaging driving game designed specifically for toddlers and young kids (ages 3-5). In this colorful, kid-friendly world, little drivers can take control of a truck and explore a vibrant city while learning basic skills in an intuitive and stress-free way.

Features:

🎮 Easy Controls – Designed for little hands! Learn to use a controller or keyboard with simple movement mechanics.
🌆 Explore a Stylized Town – Drive freely around a playful, colorful city with no rules or pressure.
🔢 Learn Numbers – Drive into numbered zones to hear numbers spoken out loud.
🎨 Discover Colors – Enter color spheres to hear and see colors change in real-time.
🛞 No Failures, Just Fun! – A relaxed, no-pressure environment where kids can explore at their own pace.
🎵 Kid-Friendly Sounds & Voices – Encouraging voice prompts and cheerful sound effects make learning fun.

Perfect for young children learning to use a controller, Truck Town: Kids and Toddlers Driving Game is a delightful first driving experience that blends fun with early learning. 🚛💨
